items.title: Walter "Furry" Lewis Interview, 1968-09-02
items.q: And I think Faith Marby was on the steam of Calpso.

ctx.x: Do you think he was from New Orleans? Yeah, he was. He was from New Orleans. Maybe, uh, it took, uh, tell me more about him.

It took my new ball. Yeah, because, uh, he took older than I was. He was around that circle more than I was. Yeah. Yeah. And, uh, I came up afterwards, you know, and a lot of those guys named, like, Red Caillou, he died. Do you know when Red Caillou died? Do you know when Red Caillou died? No, I don't. No, I don't. But I knew of those guys, you know? Yeah. Yeah. And, uh, frankly speaking, now, like Red Caillou, I think he used to work, uh, he used to work on the steam of Calpso. Really? On the riverboat? Yeah.…
Did, uh, you have a band job or a solo job? On the steam of Calpso? Well, both. Both. Also, solo on the, on the riverboat. I thought it was mostly band.
